authority: public discovery and simulation-intent routing only; no live-business mutation authority is granted by discovery
boundaries: simulation outputs are modeled scenarios, not guarantees, predictions, accounting statements, legal advice, tax advice, investment advice or financing approval
assumptions, inputs, uncertainty, confidence and evidence state must remain visible so modeled output is not confused with observed reality
simulation cannot mutate live payroll, jobs, customer records, payments, contracts or other production business systems
external actions, purchases, hiring, firing, financing, contracting, publishing and other consequential moves remain human-confirmed
Evercraft InternalOps and live operating systems remain separate from the simulation environment
the current public cockpit URL and production customer execution path are not represented as verified here until independently confirmed

commercial.pricing: No public price is represented as verified in this record.
commercial.payment_state: Discovery creates no payment obligation. No paid cockpit entitlement is represented as verified here.

decision_to_execution.description: Use Systemia Remote Ops to model a consequential business decision first. Any real-world execution remains separately authorized.

evercraft_portfolio.description: A simulation may reveal a genuine operational need and route to the smallest relevant verified Evercraft capability without forcing a product match.
